Title: Create production-ready application

Acceptance_Criteria: A clean checkout installs and builds with documented commands | environment variables have safe examples | a deployment runs a health check | no secrets are committed.

Title: Isolated synthetic showcase café
User_Story: As a product owner, I want a resettable fictional café so reviewers can explore realistic staff, rosters, attendance and payroll preparation.
Acceptance_Criteria: Use a dedicated verified isolated demo environment | seed 12–15 fictional employees and FOH/BOH departments | include realistic roster, availability, attendance, corrections and approved payroll CSV sample | no real user or customer data | no real outbound messages or payroll | never seed an unidentified or production tenant
Evidence: Verified separate local showcase: independent signing/API keys; dedicated internal network/storage; 14 fictional FOH/BOH staff; published rosters/open shifts; availability; immutable clocks/correction; 14 approved/finalised sample CSV rows. Guarded reset/reseed and exact-volume restart passed. Focused Node/HTTP 31/31; pgTAP 74/74; showcase browser 1/1 plus ordinary report/CSV 2/2; production builds, lint/types passed. Loopback-only reviewer launcher verified. Documentation updated. Hosted access and broader SAAS-003 remain unverified. See IMPLEMENTATION_PROGRESS.md.

Title: Guided owner, manager and employee showcase journeys
User_Story: As a reviewer, I want guided realistic workflows so I can evaluate Butterbox end to end.
Acceptance_Criteria: Provide repeatable owner, manager, employee and payroll-prep walkthroughs | cover business setup, people, roster, shifts, attendance, approvals and CSV | accurate role accounts and accessible steps | clearly mark unavailable features | do not simulate unimplemented behavior as real
Evidence: Role-based User Guide baseline walkthroughs verified through actual login/navigation: provisioned setup/checklist; 14 staff; two scoped manager teams; published/open shifts; prior approved/finalised time; real sample CSV download; mobile employee schedule/availability/history and direct permission denial. Four targeted production journeys passed; mobile axe/overflow passed; post-walkthrough HTTP integrity 1/1; lint/types/build passed. Existing label/CSV browser also passed. Fresh onboarding, new offer/clock/approval and provider delivery explicitly not claimed. Documentation updated; see IMPLEMENTATION_PROGRESS.md.
